big_injuries.name: Ja Morant
big_injuries.detail: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

players.name: Jalen Johnson
players.detail: Johnson is questionable to suit up for Friday's game against Washington.

players.name: Jock Landale
players.detail: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

players.name: Keshon Gilbert
players.detail: Gilbert is out for Friday's game against the Wizards due to left knee inflammation.

players.name: Asa Newell
players.detail: Newell (toe) is out for Friday's game against Washington.

players.name: Mouhamed Gueye
players.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Henri Veesaar
players.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

players.name: Egor Demin
players.detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

players.name: Day'Ron Sharpe
players.detail: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.

players.name: Noah Clowney
players.detail: Clowney (knee) supplied seven points (3-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist over 17 minutes during Wednesday's 114-104 victory over the Hornets.

players.name: Tyler Bilodeau
players.detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

players.name: Jarrett Allen
players.detail: Allen (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

players.name: Peyton Watson
players.detail: Watson (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Jaylon Tyson
players.detail: Tyson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Tyrese Proctor
players.detail: Proctor (ankle) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: DeMar DeRozan
players.detail: DeRozan has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors due to lower-back spasms.

players.name: Julian Strawther
players.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

players.name: Spencer Jones
players.detail: Jones (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

players.name: Jimmy Butler III
players.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

players.name: Moses Moody
players.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

players.name: Kristaps Porzingis
players.detail: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.

players.name: Gui Santos
players.detail: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.

players.name: Steven Adams
players.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Clint Capela
players.detail: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

players.name: Tyrese Haliburton
players.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
players.detail: Oubre (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

players.name: T.J. McConnell
players.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks and remains week-to-week.

players.name: Johnny Furphy
players.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

players.name: Ben Sheppard
players.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Josh Hart
players.detail: Hart is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to right ankle soreness.

players.name: Jalen Williams
players.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Chet Holmgren
players.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

players.name: Cason Wallace
players.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Nikola Topic
players.detail: Topic (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

players.name: Jaylin Williams
players.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

players.name: Thomas Sorber
players.detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

players.name: Paolo Banchero
players.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jalen Suggs
players.detail: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Noah Penda
players.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jonathan Isaac
players.detail: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

players.name: Izaiyah Nelson
players.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

players.name: Mark Williams
players.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jordan Goodwin
players.detail: Goodwin (calf) is out for Thursday's game against Orlando.

players.name: Rasheer Fleming
players.detail: Fleming is out for Thursday's game against the Magic due to a sprained left ankle.

players.name: Ja Morant
players.detail: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

players.name: Shaedon Sharpe
players.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Vit Krejci
players.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Tobias Harris
players.detail: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

players.name: Jayden Quaintance
players.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

players.name: Anthony Davis
players.detail: Davis is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks due to a right ankle sprain, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tristan Vukcevic
players.detail: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

players.name: Jamir Watkins
players.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

players.name: Justin Champagnie
players.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

players.name: Reece Beekman
players.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
